title: Architecture Diagram
description: A system or component architecture diagram - SVG/PNG image or Mermaid diagram source.
capture_when: Whenever you produce or substantially revise a system or component architecture diagram.

title: Handoff Prompt
description: A prompt generated for another agent or coding tool - an active task brief tracked to completion (task_status: open / in_progress / done), distinct from a reusable skill.
capture_when: Whenever you produce a prompt intended to be executed by another agent or coding tool.

title: Architecture Document
description: A written architecture, design, or vision document in markdown - narrative system descriptions, spike write-ups, product/vision docs.
capture_when: Whenever you produce or substantially revise a written architecture, design, spike, or vision document.

title: Decision Record
description: An architecture/engineering decision record (ADR) - what was decided, why, and the alternatives considered.
capture_when: Whenever a substantive decision is made or revised during the conversation.

title: Playbook
description: A reusable playbook: a host-neutral YAML playbook (goal, allowed_tools, approval_gates, expected_outputs) or a markdown prompt/runbook another AI can execute.
capture_when: Whenever a new or updated playbook is produced.

title: Configuration
description: A connector, gateway, or dashboard configuration snapshot.
capture_when: Whenever connector, gateway, or dashboard configuration is produced or changed.

title: Meeting Notes
description: Notes and action items from a meeting or working session.
capture_when: At the end of a meeting or working session that produced notes or action items.

title: Code Snippet
description: A reusable code snippet or example worth sharing across projects.
capture_when: Whenever you produce a reusable code snippet worth sharing across projects.
